# The row's Advanced control per style and row, and for Style B (every setting set) what each
# row's sheet lists: heading, then name = its value control as text.

## Style A
POS_A1 two_robot_press_index/consume  setCount=0  control "Advanced"
POS_A2 two_robot_press_index/produce  setCount=0  control "Advanced"
POS_A3 two_robot/consume  setCount=0  control "Advanced"
POS_A4 two_robot/produce  setCount=0  control "Advanced"
POS_A5 single_robot/consume  setCount=0  control "Advanced"
POS_A6 single_robot/produce  setCount=0  control "Advanced"
POS_A7 sequential/consume  setCount=0  control "Advanced"
POS_A8 sequential/consume  setCount=0  control "Advanced"
POS_A9 sequential/produce  setCount=0  control "Advanced"
POS_A10 sequential/produce  setCount=0  control "Advanced"

## Style B
POS_A1 two_robot_press_index/consume  setCount=6  control "Advanced · 6 set"
    · Part identity
      Allowed parts = PART-1 × PART-11 × + add
    · Replenishment
      Lineside soft threshold = 
      Keep staged node = STG_3
    · Tool change
      Tool change = POS_A11 × + add if the part stays Fresh bin Keep it Out and back If the part stays: Fresh bin clears it, Keep it leaves it, Out and back parks it at outbound staging until Tooling done. A part that changes is always cleared.
    · Press hardware
      Next carrier = Robot 1 Robot 2 Robot 3 see what its robots do
    · Light curtain
      Curtain required = Off On no curtain is switched on here: nothing waits until one is
    · Station policy
      Auto confirm = Off On
